comment: This model has no parameters, inputs or outputs: config(0,0,0,0) at src/plugin.cpp:188, and the four blank models differ only in the HP passed to the shared SticksyBlankModule constructor (src/plugin.cpp:341 to 344). Everything the module does is on the panel context menu, built at src/plugin.cpp:319. setMode at src/plugin.cpp:204 returns without doing anything while any sticker is loaded. The Background menu is cosmetic, which STYLE would normally leave out, but a decorative blank panel is the exception it names: the finish is what the module is for. init() at src/plugin.cpp:836 calls ensureDefaultSticksyLibraryInstalled, which creates <Rack user folder>/Sticksy/Stickers and <Rack user folder>/Sticksy/Animation/vc_cat and copies the plugin's bundled SVGs into them; it writes nothing else and keeps no settings file. Storage is the plugin-wide menu item that changes behaviour rather than appearance, so by STYLE's rule it is written on all four blanks. Multiple-mode placement is random within one HP of each panel edge, with a rotation of plus or minus 18 degrees (src/plugin.cpp:283).
